messages:
Priya Nair: Quick update 24 hrs - due to the unexpected regional holiday in EMEA we've pushed the final review submission cutoff for EMEA folks to Monday EOD (23:59 CET). All other regions remain Friday EOD (5pm PT). Please note: this is only for contributors based in EMEA or who were explicitly out for the holiday.

Ethan Brooks: Thanks @Priya. Does that extension mean the calibration panel moves too? I have reviewers booked for Fri and can't make Mon.

Priya Nair: Good point. Calibration panels stay on the original calendar slots this week. People-ops will run a supplemental EMEA panel Monday 9-10am CET for any packets submitted after Friday. If you have reviewers who can't attend, flag them in the tracker and we'll reassign.

Lisa Morales: We have two contractors who started mid-cycle  do they get full review packets or a condensed review?

Maya Chen: Contractors get a condensed packet (focus on deliverables + collaboration). Add them in the tracker under "contractor-pack" and we'll set reviewers accordingly. Full reviews apply after 6 months tenure.

Oliver Park: Recusal Q: if a reviewer had direct involvement in a large project for a reviewee, should they recuse from the calibration discussion?

Maya Chen: Short answer: yes for calibration panel voting. We ask any reviewer with close involvement to recuse from the panel vote but they can remain to provide context if asked. Mark recusal in the review packet (checkbox) so we can count quorum correctly.

Ethan Brooks: Where do I mark recusal in the tracker? I couldn't find the checkbox.

Maya Chen: It's on the reviewer-assignment row  column "recuse?". If it's not visible, toggle the "advanced columns" view in the tracker. I'll post a screenshot in a sec.

HR Bot: People-ops checklist updated: 1) EMEA extension set, 2) Supplemental panel added, 3) Recusal checkbox added. Use `/reviews help` for tracker shortcuts.

Priya Nair: One more logistics note: attachments need to be uploaded 12 hours before the panel to allow anonymization and prep. If you upload after that cutoff and need it for the panel, DM people-ops and we'll try to fast-track but no guarantees.

Lisa Morales: For calibration prep, can we see anonymized examples from prior cycles? That helps calibrate severity of behaviors.

Maya Chen: Yes  we've redacted three anonymized cases and added them to the prep folder: https://intranet.redwood/docs/calibration-examples. Also added a 20-min dry run on Thu 4pm PT for reviewers who want to sync on examples.

Oliver Park: If a manager needs to request an emergency extension (family emergency, sudden hospitalization), what's the workflow?

Maya Chen: Emergency extensions are triaged by people-ops. Steps: 1) Submit `/exceptions add [employee-id] emergency` in the tracker OR email people-ops@redwood.com with subject line "Emergency exception: [employee]". 2) Include brief reason and proposed new submission date. We aim to approve within 24 hours.

Ethan Brooks: Will approved exceptions be visible to reviewers? Any privacy concerns?

Maya Chen: Only people-ops and the calibration admin see the reason text. Reviewers will see an "exception-approved" flag and the adjusted deadline but not the sensitive details.

Priya Nair: Awesome. Please confirm in the tracker if you expect any exceptions by EOD today so we can plan panel quorum.

HR Bot: Reminder: valid upload formats = .pdf, .docx, .md, google links. To attach via Slack: use `/upload [employee-id] [link]`. To list pending exceptions: `/exceptions list`.

Lisa Morales: Marked two contractor packets and one recusal.

Ethan Brooks: Marked my reviewers and requested a temporary reassignment for one reviewer who is OOO Fri.

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone. We'll send a final calendar + attendee list by 7pm PT. If you need help with PDFs or redaction, reach out and we'll help with conversions and anonymization. :white_check_mark:
